_comment: Scaffold contract. `brmbh create` reads this to turn the starter into a client project. It lives in the theme, not the CLI, so the theme can change its own identity without a CLI release. Deleted from scaffolds.

textDomain._comment: The i18n domain. Rewritten only where it is unambiguously a text domain: the trailing argument of an i18n call, load_theme_textdomain()'s first argument, block.json's textdomain key, and @package tags.

preserve._comment: Framework identifiers, NOT project identity. Renaming these breaks things for no benefit — only one theme is active at a time, so there is nothing to collide with.

delete._comment: Starter-repo infrastructure. A client project neither needs nor should ship it. Kept deliberately: AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, which are the agent operating contract and belong in every project.
